entry_point: pnpm openclaw gateway run; pnpm openclaw agent; gateway call sessions.reset/sessions.create/sessions.get
pipeline: Completed parent turn -> real reset -> real held MCP tool -> last-completed fork -> child model request captured over HTTP
state: Gateway-owned SQLite, isolated HOME/workspace/state and free loopback ports
external_fixtures: Model responses and MCP result data were scripted locally. No remote model inference or account credentials.
liveness_evidence: The actual MCP request remained blocked until after the child completed. A full fork was rejected as active, while last-completed succeeded. No test-only active-run flag or seeded transcript writes.
controls: No-reset forks retain completed history. Full forks after parent completion retain the new task/result and exclude cleared history. Parent messages stay unchanged while the tool is held, and the task completes after release.
limits: Validates runtime state, persistence and request content; not remote model reasoning or UI interactions.
